Name: Farmer Phone
Author: Hayakawadono
Description:
Adds a skin and a background for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url] mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url] that tries to complement the design of the original game's User Interface and aesthetics.
To install, just simply extract this archive inside the Mods folder.

Downloads.Description: Drag and drop the contents of this archive into the Mods folder.

Manifest.Name: Farmer Phone
Manifest.Description: Adds a Mobile Phone skin that complements the game's own User Interface design.
